column1: # Follow-up probes for Epic's error 3582 on data members (#724): what OpenVerse does is in each probe's header and in note; the Book's expectation where it has one; Epic's outcome and lines in epic_outcome and epic_lines (UEFN 43.12, ++Fortnite+Release-43.12-CL-60598086, compiled with BuildAll 2026-11-18/19, the admitted ones run with Use Verse VM, newVerseVm=true, 2026-11-19; - where not yet compiled), its diagnostics in note with L the 0-based body line. The probes marked admitted or refused in their note only were compiled and not run: each asks about one construct in a data member's definition.

column7: note
Same (control: an archetype's field value in a function is no data member). OpenVerse: size 3.

Same. Epic: 3582 L8 "Divergent calls (calls that might not complete) cannot be used to define data-members" at MakeThing's arguments. OpenVerse: the value of the constant Shared calls MakeThing, which might not complete (before #724: refused because MakeThing writes).

Same. Epic: 3512 L5 "This archetype instantiation constructs a class that has the 'transacts' effect, which is not allowed by its context". OpenVerse: the value of the constant Shared constructs thing, which has the effect <writes>, citing 3512.
Same verdict, other reason. Epic: 3565 L2 "The 'converges' effect is only allowed on native functions". OpenVerse: <converges> is unsupported (#494).
Same since #724. Epic: 3582 L2 at Min's arguments, nothing for Abs. OpenVerse: the value of the constant Limit calls Min, which might not complete (before #724: admitted, limit 3).
Same verdict. Epic: 3582 L7 at Double's call and 3512 L6 for Shared:thing = thing{}. OpenVerse reports the first, 3512's reason at L6 (constructs thing, <writes>).
Same: operators, Floor of a rational and failure with or are admitted. OpenVerse: half 1.
Same since #724. Epic: 3582 L5 at Count's call. OpenVerse: the default of field 'Size' of thing calls Count, which might not complete (before #724: refused for Count's no_rollback effect, 3512).
Same. Epic: 3582 L5. OpenVerse: the default of field 'Size' of thing calls Count, which might not complete (before #724: #511's convergence message).
Same verdict, other reason. Epic: 3565 L2. OpenVerse: <converges> is unsupported (#494).
Same (control: a local constant is no data member). OpenVerse: limit 3.
Epic (2026-11-19): admitted (compiled only, not run). Asks whether Abs, which the Book's Runtime API reference declares <converges>, is admitted. OpenVerse: admitted, limit 3.

Epic (2026-11-19): refused, 3582 "Divergent calls (calls that might not complete) cannot be used to define data-members". Min alone (div-const-intrinsic has it around Abs). OpenVerse: refused, calls Min (3582).

Epic (2026-11-19): refused, 3582 "Divergent calls (calls that might not complete) cannot be used to define data-members". Floor of a float (<reads><predicts><decides> in the API reference). OpenVerse: refused, calls Floor of a float (3582).

Epic (2026-11-19): refused, 3582 "Divergent calls (calls that might not complete) cannot be used to define data-members". Quotient (<computes><predicts><decides>). OpenVerse: refused, calls Quotient (3582).
Epic (2026-11-19): admitted (compiled only, not run). BitAnd (an intrinsic, <converges>). OpenVerse: admitted, mask 2.
Epic (2026-11-19): refused, 3582 "Divergent calls (calls that might not complete) cannot be used to define data-members". Sqrt (<predicts><reads>). OpenVerse: refused, calls Sqrt (3582).

Epic (2026-11-19): refused, 3582 "Divergent calls (calls that might not complete) cannot be used to define data-members". ToString of an int (<computes><predicts>). OpenVerse: refused, calls ToString (3582).

Epic (2026-11-19): refused, 3582 "Divergent calls (calls that might not complete) cannot be used to define data-members". An int interpolated into a string, no call written. OpenVerse: refused, calls ToString to interpolate an int (3582); if Epic admits it: text base 6.
Epic (2026-11-19): admitted (compiled only, not run). An array's Length (<converges>). OpenVerse: admitted, count 3.
Epic (2026-11-19): admitted (compiled only, not run). Indexing with or (<converges><decides>). OpenVerse: admitted, first 4.
Epic (2026-11-19): admitted (compiled only, not run). array{1} + array{2} (<converges>). OpenVerse: admitted, length 2.
Epic (2026-11-19): admitted (compiled only, not run). An archetype of a <computes> class (the Book's test is assert_valid, compile only). OpenVerse: admitted, x 1.

Epic (2026-11-19): refused, 3512 "This archetype instantiation constructs a class that has the 'transacts' effect, which is not allowed by its context". An archetype of a struct without specifiers. OpenVerse: refused, constructs pair, <writes> (#512's transacts construction, 3512's reading); if Epic admits it: sum 3.
Epic (2026-11-19): admitted (compiled only, not run). An enum value. OpenVerse: admitted, green.
Epic (2026-11-19): admitted (compiled only, not run). option{3}. OpenVerse: admitted, value 3.
Epic (2026-11-19): admitted (compiled only, not run). A tuple of literals. OpenVerse: admitted, second 2.
Epic (2026-11-19): admitted (compiled only, not run). A map literal. OpenVerse: admitted, a 1.

Epic (2026-11-19): refused, 3502 "Only <final> fields may be referenced from the default value of a data member, and `A` is not <final>". A field default that reads another field of its object: the Book's tests say 3502. OpenVerse: refused, unknown identifier 'A'.
Epic (2026-11-19): admitted (compiled only, not run). A field default that reads a field of a module constant's object (no call). OpenVerse: admitted, size 4.

Epic (2026-11-19): refused, 3582 "Divergent calls (calls that might not complete) cannot be used to define data-members". Min in a field default (built-ins in field defaults as in constants). OpenVerse: refused, calls Min (3582).

Epic (2026-11-19): refused, 3582 "Divergent calls (calls that might not complete) cannot be used to define data-members". A module-scoped var weak_map(session, int) initialised by a call of a <computes> function. OpenVerse: refused before the rule, session is no class with <module_scoped_var_weak_map_key>; with such a key it refuses the call (3582, the module-scoped var's default).
